title: Deja vu LFO waves: stored random loops and scales (DJ01)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only. Nine LFO waveforms after the stock seven, on all three LFOs of every track (audio and MIDI): DV-F, a free-running loop of stored random values; DV-T, the same restarted at its first value by a trig; PMAJ, PMIN, HIRA, WTON, DORI, LYDI, OCTA, the DV-F loop rounded to that scale when DEST is the machine's tuning (TUNE, TUN1, TUN2, MAST, PITCH), DV-F on any other destination. On these waves MODE is the loop length (FREE 2, TRIG 4, HOLD 8, ONE 16, HALF 32 values) and SPH the mutation (0 a new value at every step, up to 63 fewer, 64 the loop kept, above 64 more and more swaps, 127 a swap at every step); SPD and MULT set the rate (16 steps per LFO cycle, as RAND), FADE and DEP are stock. The behaviour and names follow Kari Gardarsson's Digitakt II Musical WAVE / Deja Vu (whose release credits Bezronczek's Syntakt Firmware Workbench), an idea from the deja vu of Emilie Gillet's Marbles; this is our own code. WAVE 7..15 save, load and p-lock as any stock value; the loops themselves are not saved (made anew after power-on). For dn2-cfw's DJ01 build.
